skills.name: llm-attack-surface
skills.description: Map and harden the attack surface of an LLM/agent system: prompt injection (direct/indirect), jailbreak, tool abuse, data exfiltration, and the offense-defense loop. Includes a red-team checklist for auditing your own agent. Framework: OWASP LLM Top 10 + first-party agent-runtime practice.

skills.name: mcp-permission-audit
skills.description: Audit MCP servers wired into an agent runtime: who can change their code, how many tools they expose, who approves calls, and what can fire while nobody is watching. Companion to secure-addon-install.

skills.name: secure-addon-install
skills.description: Safely install third-party skills, plugins, MCP servers, or Python packages into an AI agent runtime: pre-install snapshot, post-install health check, and rollback when things break. War-story driven, agent-agnostic.

skills.name: silent-failure-sweep
skills.description: Periodically sweep an agent's cron jobs, scripts, and pipelines for silent failures: swallowed stderr, existence-only success checks, stale artifacts, dead probes. Companion to secure-addon-install.

skills.name: skill-review-checklist
skills.description: Deep vetting workflow for third-party SKILL.md packages before they enter an agent runtime: provenance, instruction-level threats, context budget, behavioral traps, and an install/no-install verdict. Companion to secure-addon-install.

routes.when: installing, adding, or updating any skill / plugin / MCP server / python package into a live agent runtime
an install or update took the gateway, cron, or tooling down and you need a clean rollback
vetting a third-party SKILL.md or skill pack before it enters the runtime (provenance, instruction threats, context budget)
deciding whether an MCP server's permissions, exposed tool count, or unattended actions are acceptable
a cron job or pipeline reports success but the output is stale, empty, or never changes
designing or auditing an LLM/agent attack surface: prompt injection, tool abuse, data exfiltration, supply chain
running a periodic maintenance sweep of scheduled jobs, probes, and artifact freshness
